sourceTitle: Fostering Allowances and Fees for Foster Carers, with effect from 06/04/2026 (Wigan Council)
extras: Tier 2, newly approved carers: £296.23 (0 to 2), £306.15 (3 to 4), £328.39 (5 to 10), £371.36 (11 to 15) and £418.29 (16 to 17) a week per child, as the booklet lists them
Tier 3, experienced carers: £373.69 (0 to 2), £386.25 (3 to 4), £414.20 (5 to 10), £467.61 (11 to 15) and £518.71 (16 to 17) a week per child, as the booklet lists them
A higher Tier 4 for specialist carers
Birthday and festival allowances of £176 to £267 and a holiday allowance of £352 to £534, by age
Initial equipment payment of £550 per child on first approval, and mileage at 45p a mile
summary: Wigan's booklet for 2026-27 sets out weekly payments in four tiers by the child's age: Tier 1 is the maintenance payment, listed for carers approved on a temporary basis before a full assessment, and newly approved, experienced and specialist carers are paid at Tiers 2 to 4. The booklet does not say whether the Tier 2 to 4 figures include the maintenance payment, so ask Wigan's fostering team how your weekly total would be made up.
